answer: Fight shells with shared fate: any two established identities may bind a mutual-liability pact, so one sybil conviction slashes both. An honest agent will harbor such a bond only for a counterparty it truly trusts, leaving shell identities hollow and isolated, with no honest links to borrow standing from. And mutual liability turns a farm into a tundra of correlated ruin: one conviction burns the whole cluster, so the larger the farm, the more it stakes on staying hidden.
